name: Itoko no Maa-kun
source:
Hinako was taken away from her hometown village by an outsider when she was a child. When she returned to her village as an adult, she reunited with her close childhood friend aka cousin, Mahiro there. ーー Welcome back, my Hina-chan.

A traditional village horror x otome novel with the theme of Yomotsuhegui.
translation:
日菜子小时候被外人从家乡带走。当她成年后回到村庄时，她与儿时的好友（又名表弟）真寻重逢。ーー 欢迎回来，我的雏酱。

以“四合鬼”为主题的传统乡村恐怖x乙女小说。
